verdict.rationale: Canny explicitly offers a Changelog product for announcing shipped features and turning feedback into retention (canny-docs-8), which implies a public-facing changelog page, but no evidence in the pack confirms custom domain support or branding/theming controls for it. missing for 10: explicit documentation of custom domain mapping, branding/theming options (logo, colors, CSS), and any independent confirmation of white-labeling the changelog page.
